question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate collocation:
She ___ the table before dinner.
solution:
The correct answer is '**set**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct collocation to use with “the table” in this context is “**set**.”
 
• “Set the table” is a common phrase that means to arrange items such as plates, utensils, and glasses on the table before a meal.
